briefing.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 launch intensifies US-China AGI competition as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models amid record funding and regulatory scrutiny. US export controls on advanced chips tighten as China accelerates domestic alternatives. Multi-agent security protocols gain traction for production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases GPT-6 with 4x context window; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind drops Gemini 3; xAI ships Grok-3; DeepSeek unveils R2. Meta open-sources Llama 4 under new safety tier.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra at scale; Microsoft and Oracle announce $50B joint data center expansion; TSMC 2nm yields improve for AI accelerators. Sovereign AI clusters in UAE and Saudi Arabia reach 100k H100 equivalents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect negotiation protocols become mandatory for critical infrastructure before 2028?
